measurements.title: Neck
measurements.description: Measure around your neck at the height where your collar, if buttoned, would naturally sit.

measurements.title: Shoulder
measurements.description: Measure straight across the back from the end of the right shoulder seam to the end of the left shoulder.

measurements.title: Sleeve Length
measurements.description: Measure from the top of your shoulder down along the arm to the knuckle of your thumb.

measurements.title: Bicep
measurements.description: Measure around the fullest part of your bicep with your arm relaxed.

measurements.title: Wrist
measurements.description: Measure snugly around the fullest part of your wrist.

measurements.title: Chest
measurements.description: Measure around the fullest part of your chest. Ensure the tape is level and firm around the body.

measurements.title: Belly
measurements.description: Measure around the widest part of your stomach, typically right across or just above the belly button area.

measurements.title: Waist
measurements.description: Measure around your natural waistline at the exact level where you normally wear your trousers' belt.

measurements.title: Hip
measurements.description: Measure around your hips and the largest part of your buttocks.

measurements.title: Jacket Length
measurements.description: Measure vertically from the base of the back of your neck down to the point where your thumb knuckle rests.

measurements.title: Trousers Length
measurements.description: Measure from the top of your waistband down your outer leg to your desired ankle length.

measurements.title: Thigh
measurements.description: Measure around your upper thigh at its widest point just below the crotch.

questions.question: Should I add extra wearing ease to my measurements?
questions.answer: No. Please provide your exact anatomical body measurements. Our master tailoring team calculates all necessary structural ease and posture adjustments for you.

questions.question: What if I prefer using my standard suit size?
questions.answer: If you already wear a standard ready-to-wear suit size (e.g., EU/US 40, 42, 44 or S/M/L/XL) from unadjusted garments, you can simply share that size with us during your consultation.

questions.question: Can I have another professional tailor measure me?
questions.answer: Yes. If you cannot visit our Kigali atelier, you may have an experienced local tailor take your measurements using this 12-point guide and submit the numbers to us.

questions.question: Can I take my measurements at home?
questions.answer: Yes, but we strictly recommend having a trusted family member or friend assist you to ensure absolute tape accuracy.
